pf.license.need: Depends on the state. Many states license nobody to pressure wash. Some ask for a contractor registration or license, some only above a job-size amount, and some counties license it. The state's form says which.
pf.license.moss_and_algae: A moss or algae treatment is pesticide work. Where the state's rules require it, the business holds a pesticide business license and each person who sprays holds an applicator license.
pf.license.lead_safe: Washing painted surfaces on a home built before 1978: a lead-safe firm certificate and a certified renovator on the crew, where the rules require them.
pf.license.ask: The registration or license number the state's form names for pressure washing; for moss treatment, the business's pesticide license and each applicator's number.
pf.license.who_holds: Pressure washing: the business, where a state asks. Moss treatment: the business and each applicator. Lead-safe work: the firm and one certified renovator on the crew.
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
pf.license.blocks_live: nothing waits on a license (D96): the business and each person go live once set up and the owner says yes; a job the owner says needs a license they don't have isn't booked
pf.license.job_size_line: Where a license is needed only above a job-size amount, Rosie checks each job's total, an add-on too, against it.
pf.license.insurance_bond: Liability insurance or a bond is shown as given by the business, not checked by Rosie. Where the state's rules require a bond, it's asked at sign-up.
pf.license.background_checks: Only where the state's rules require them, or as the business's own word.
pf.license.not_this_work: Paint stripping, roof repairs and sealing work that needs a contractor's license are not pressure washing.

what_happens: A sagging or leaking roof: a roofer looks first, and nobody stays in rooms under a sagging spot. The roof part isn't booked; the driveway or house wash can be.
A mix swallowed or in the eyes: call Poison Control now at 1-800-222-1222, or 911 if they have trouble breathing. No booking from that message.
Power lines over the work: that part is left for the power company to make safe first.
A gas smell or a leaking propane tank: leave and call 911. No booking until it's safe.

pf.visit.check_in: Someone home: the code at the door, entered by the crew lead. Nobody home: no code; the lead texts DONE with after photos.
pf.visit.ready_to_start: A working outside spigot (or the crew's tank), the cars moved, and the side gate open. Missing: the crew waits 15 minutes, then Sam decides about the trip fee.
pf.visit.before_photos: Before photos of each surface, its cracks and old stains, the plants and anything nearby.
pf.visit.water_and_drains: Wash water is kept out of storm drains: the drain is covered and the water is recovered, where local rules require it.
pf.visit.plants_and_pets: Plants are wet down and covered before any mix, and rinsed after. Pets stay inside until the surfaces dry.
pf.visit.lead_safe: On a painted pre-1978 home: sheeting on the ground, windows near the work closed, warning signs, low pressure only, and the water and chips collected.
pf.visit.wind: No spraying a mix or a treatment in gusty wind. The sprayed part moves free; the rest goes on.
pf.visit.drop_off: At the wash bay: the code is given at the counter when the item is left. READY comes with a photo. Pick-up only by the customer or someone they name.
pf.visit.changes_at_visit: Extra work only when the customer says yes to its price first. Work sold at the home comes with a right to cancel where the state's rules give one.
pf.visit.proof_done: After photos from the same angles as the before photos. DONE with after photos when nobody's home.
pf.visit.aftercare: Keep cars off a washed driveway for 1 hour. After a moss treatment, the moss dies off over a few weeks and rain washes it away: never pressure wash the roof.

Wind at the house on the day: the sprayed part moves free, and the rest goes on.
A treatment needs a dry day after: rain due within the label's dry time moves it, free.
No water or no way in: the crew waits 15 minutes, then Sam decides about the trip fee.
Plants or a car hurt by a mix: photos on the secure page; the owner decides. Rosie never admits fault or offers money.
Streaks or missed spots: tell the business within 7 days for a free touch-up.
A crew member is out: a new person is offered first; no answer, the rest of the crew comes for longer.
An item at the wash bay not picked up: reminders; after the free days, a storage fee only if the owner starts it, after written notice.
pf.edges.rest: All other edge cases are handled the generic way.
